data.title: V2X Awarded Position on $46 Million U.S. Air Force Contract Supporting B-52 Long Range Standoff Cruise Missile Program
data.description:
V2X Awarded Position on $46 Million U.S. Air Force Contract Supporting B-52 Long Range Standoff Cruise Missile Program

V2X Awarded Position on $46 Million U.S. Air Force Contract Supporting B-52 Long Range Standoff Cruise Missile Program

PR Newswire

RESTON, Va., Sept. 15, 2026

RESTON, Va., Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- V2X Inc. (NYSE: VVX) has been awarded a position on a $46 million delivery order on the Enterprise-Wide Agile Acquisition Contract Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity contract supporting the U.S. Air Force's Carriage Equipment Production Effort for the Long Range Standoff (LRSO) cruise missile program.

The LRSO program is a critical modernization effort for the U.S. Air Force and an essential component of the nation's strategic deterrent. Designed for deployment from the B-52 Stratofortress, the Long Range cruise missile will replace the currently fielded Air-Launched Cruise Missile, ensuring the Air Force's long-range strike capability remains effective against evolving threats for decades to come.

Under the contract, V2X will provide carriage equipment production supporting the integration of the LRSO weapon system on the B-52, reinforcing the company's role in advancing next-generation defense capabilities that strengthen mission readiness and national security.

"Supporting the modernization of the B-52 and our nation's strategic deterrent is a responsibility we take seriously," said Jeremy C. Wensinger, President and Chief Executive Officer of V2X. "This award reflects the trust our customer places in V2X to deliver high-quality solutions that enable mission success and support one of the Air Force's highest modernization priorities."

V2X delivers integrated mission solutions that enhance readiness and operational effectiveness across the air, land, sea, space, and cyber domains. The company's expertise in engineering, manufacturing, sustainment, and mission support enables customers to address today's most complex defense challenges while preparing for tomorrow's evolving mission requirements.

About V2X
V2X builds innovative solutions that integrate physical and digital environments by aligning people, actions, and technology. V2X is embedded in all elements of a critical mission's lifecycle to enhance readiness, optimize resource management, and boost security. The company provides innovation spanning national security, defense, civilian, and international markets. With a global team of approximately 16,000 professionals, V2X enables mission success by injecting AI and machine learning capabilities to meet today's toughest challenges across all operational domains.

data.title: OCEAN Earns SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type 2 Attestations, Bringing Independent Assurance to Permissionless Bitcoin Mining
data.description:
OCEAN Earns SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type 2 Attestations, Bringing Independent Assurance to Permissionless Bitcoin Mining

OCEAN Earns SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type 2 Attestations, Bringing Independent Assurance to Permissionless Bitcoin Mining

PR Newswire

CHEYENNE, Wyo., Sept. 15, 2026

Independent examinations affirm the controls behind OCEAN's operations.

CHEYENNE, Wyo., Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Mummolin, Inc. today announced that its subsidiary, Bitcoin OCEAN LLC, operator of the OCEAN Bitcoin mining pool, has successfully completed SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2 examinations and received both attestation reports.

The reports reinforce OCEAN's commitment to transparent, dependable Bitcoin mining through independent examination of control design and operating effectiveness of OCEAN's internal systems over the reporting periods.

"Miners should be able to trust the infrastructure they depend on," said Nick Watkins, Chief Financial Officer at OCEAN. "OCEAN makes reward information transparent. These reports give finance teams and auditors another form of evidence they can use to evaluate the controls supporting our operations."

Building on OCEAN's previous Type 1 attestations, the SOC 1 Type 2 report addresses controls relevant to customers' internal control over financial reporting. The SOC 2 Type 2 report addresses controls relevant to Security and Availability.

"Permissionless participation and independent assurance reinforce each other," said Ian Northon, Chief Legal and Compliance Officer at OCEAN. "This milestone affirms OCEAN's continued commitment to the principles we were built on: transparency, decentralization, and control in the hands of miners."

Those principles underpin OCEAN's transparent reward accounting, direct payouts from the Bitcoin network, and DATUM, which enables miners to construct their own block templates while participating in pooled mining.

The full reports are available to customers and qualified partners under NDA upon request.

About Mummolin, Inc.

Mummolin, Inc. is the parent company of Bitcoin OCEAN LLC, operator of the OCEAN mining pool. Mummolin builds transparent, decentralized Bitcoin infrastructure that returns power to miners and strengthens Bitcoin's foundational principles.

data.title: Tompkins Logistics Launches New Model for End-to-End Logistics
data.description:
Tompkins Logistics Launches New Model for End-to-End Logistics

Tompkins Logistics Launches New Model for End-to-End Logistics

PR Newswire

RALEIGH, N.C., Sept. 15, 2026

New company combines logistics execution, centralized accountability and AI-enabled intelligence

RALEIGH, N.C., Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Tompkins Logistics today announced its launch, introducing a new approach to end-to-end logistics designed to close the accountability gap in fragmented supply chain operations. Built on more than five decades of Tompkins supply chain leadership, the company combines logistics execution, network orchestration and AI-enabled intelligence into a single accountable operating model – one built to deliver outcomes, not just services.

"Companies don't need another provider managing one piece of their supply chain," said Jim Tompkins, Chairman of Tompkins Logistics. "They need a partner that can connect the pieces, continuously optimize the network and take accountability for the outcome. That's the company we built."

Watch the story

Today's logistics networks run through carriers, brokers, warehouses and internal teams that each optimize their own piece and hand off the rest, leaving customers to coordinate the whole thing themselves. Tompkins Logistics was founded to replace that arrangement with one accountable partner: centralized accountability paired with diversified execution, giving customers access to multiple providers, facilities, carriers, modes and fulfillment paths without requiring them to manage the complexity.

The company organizes its offering around seven connected capabilities: five operational solutions – Logistics Network Design & Optimization, Managed Transportation, Warehousing & Fulfillment, Freight Brokerage and Final Mile Delivery – connected by two intelligence capabilities, the Supply Chain Command Center and Cognitive Logistics Intelligence. Together, they continuously observe network conditions, recommend the next best action and orchestrate execution across providers, learning from every decision they make.

The model is familiar to the founding team, operating executives who have managed and delivered logistics across networks representing billions of dollars in annual freight.

Tompkins Logistics is built for companies that want their best people leading and improving their business, not wasting their time coordinating between fragmented providers.

About Tompkins Logistics

Tompkins Logistics is a logistics company that connects intelligence, governance and coordinated execution across a client's network through one accountable partner. Founded on more than five decades of Tompkins supply chain leadership, the company's leadership team brings more than 200 years of combined operating experience across commercial, operational, technological, legal and geographic domains.

For more information, visit tompkins-logistics.com.

data.title: BX Partners Launches Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model for Financial Advisors
data.description:
BX Partners Launches Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model for Financial Advisors

New rules-based solution combines complementary investment strategies to help advisors provide disciplined Bitcoin exposure while managing volatility

BX Partners, a research-driven investment consulting platform serving chief investment officers (CIOs), financial advisors, registered investment advisers (RIAs), and broker-dealers, today announced the launch of the BX Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model, a rules-based investment solution designed to help financial advisors incorporate Bitcoin into client portfolios through a disciplined, systematic investment process. Available through the BX Index platform, the model combines two independent investment methodologies from Dynalogic and phaseinvest to help advisors pursue Bitcoin's growth potential while seeking to reduce volatility and downside risk.

As interest in digital assets continues to grow, many financial advisors face a difficult challenge: how to address client demand for Bitcoin without exposing portfolios to the asset's historically significant volatility. Rather than relying on traditional buy-and-hold approaches or discretionary market timing, the BX Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model applies two complementary, rules-based strategies that systematically respond to changing market conditions.

"The BX Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model solves a real problem advisors face every day," said Christopher McHeffey, co-founder of BX Partners. "Their clients are asking about Bitcoin, but there hasn't been a satisfying answer between 'just don't' and 'put it all in a spot ETF and hold on.' This model gives advisors a third option: structured, transparent, and built around managing risk rather than hoping it goes up."

"What makes this model different is that it's not trying to predict Bitcoin," added Craig Cmiel, director at BX Partners. "It's designed to respond to it systematically, without emotion. The Dynalogic component sells into strength and buys into weakness by design. The phaseinvest PDE layer catches regime shifts early. Together they do what most investors struggle to do on their own."

TWO INDEPENDENT STRATEGIES. ONE DISCIPLINED INVESTMENT FRAMEWORK.

The BX Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model combines two complementary methodologies that respond to different market signals.

The Dynalogic strategy uses the iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT). It follows a tiered, price-contingent process, taking profits as Bitcoin climbs and redeploying capital at larger sizes as it falls, embedding a natural sell-high, buy-low discipline without relying on human judgment.

"Advisors don't need a reason to be interested in Bitcoin," stated Bill Flowers, founder and managing director of Dynalogic. "Their clients are already asking. What they need is a framework they can stand behind in a client meeting, something they can explain, something with a clear process, and something that doesn't make them look reckless. That's exactly what the BX Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model provides."

The phaseinvest Phase Detection Engine (PDE), developed originally for equities, identifies structural breaks in Bitcoin's volatility to determine the current market regime, then measures momentum only within that phase. When momentum is positive, the strategy holds maximum exposure. When it turns negative, it steps back and allocates to short-duration Treasuries until conditions improve.

"We built the PDE strategy because traditional momentum models have a fundamental flaw – they measure price across different market regimes, so they're always a step behind at exactly the wrong moment," said Arun Soni, CEO of phaseinvest. "By isolating momentum within its current regime, the PDE responds faster, protects capital more effectively in downturns, and gets back in sooner when conditions improve."

DESIGNED TO IMPROVE RISK-ADJUSTED OUTCOMES

In backtested results covering June 2021 through June 2026, the blended BX Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model generated a total return of 160.3%, compared with 89.3% for a traditional buy-and-hold Bitcoin strategy. During the same period, the model produced 35% lower annualized volatility while reducing maximum drawdown by 17 percentage points. All performance figures are hypothetical and based on back-tested results.

With the BX Risk-Aware Bitcoin Model, advisors can bring a disciplined, transparent Bitcoin strategy to client conversations with a documented process, a clear risk management framework, and a track record they can point to. Access is available immediately at https://bxindex.com/bitcoin-model/. The BX Bitcoin strategy is also available on the UX Wealth platform.

ABOUT BX PARTNERS

BX Partners is a research-driven investment consulting platform that supports financial professionals in building institutional-quality models with the goal of enhancing existing internal asset management platforms. BX combines quantitative, rules-based, and AI-enabled methodologies to curate high-conviction strategies designed to outperform across market cycles. The BX team conducts rigorous due diligence on many strategies each year, selecting only the ones that have the strongest potential to deliver risk-adjusted returns. The company has so far selected 25 leading research firms and 65 strategies to be included in the platform. BX is not a money manager. BX operates as a strategy engine, research partner, and open architecture solution. The BX technology suite includes the BX Advisor App, BX Risk Shield, and BX Core, giving financial professionals real-time analytics, market insights, and financial planning tools. BX Partners delivers the power behind the industry’s most innovative investment departments. To learn more about BX Partners, visit www.BXIndex.com.

data.title: Access Vascular Receives Innovative Technology Contract from Vizient for HydroMID® Midline Catheter
data.description:
Access Vascular Receives Innovative Technology Contract from Vizient for HydroMID® Midline Catheter

Access Vascular, Inc. (AVI), a medical device company specializing in developing advanced vascular access solutions, today announced its HydroMID® midline catheter has received an Innovative Technology contract from Vizient®, the nation’s largest provider-driven healthcare performance improvement company. The contract was awarded based on review of the HydroMID® device from hospital experts who serve on one of Vizient’s client-led councils, and it signifies to Vizient clients its unique qualities that potentially bring improvement to the healthcare industry.

Innovative Technology contracts are awarded following a thorough evaluation of products submitted through Vizient’s Innovative Technology Program. Vizient client-led councils identify technologies that have the potential to enhance clinical care, patient safety, healthcare worker safety or improve business operations of healthcare organizations.

AVI’s HydroMID® catheters feature a proprietary hydrogel material to help address catheter-related complications such as thrombosis and occlusion – potential sources of morbidity, readmissions, and cost for health systems. The U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA) cleared a new anti-thrombogenic indication for HydroMID® in 2025.1

“We’re excited to be awarded the Vizient Innovative Technology contract as it recognizes our clinical differentiation and potential to elevate the standard of care,” said James Biggins, Chief Executive Officer of Access Vascular. “The HydroMID® catheter has been shown to significantly reduce complication rates and is the only drug-free midline catheter indicated as anti-thrombogenic by the FDA. The Innovative Technology contract from Vizient provides us an opportunity to bring enhanced access of HydroMID® to Vizient clients, and the patients they serve.”

“Through the Vizient client-led council evaluation process, HydroMID® Midline Catheter demonstrated the potential to offer meaningful differentiation in today’s competitive landscape. After careful review, the council recommended an Innovative Technology contract to Access Vascular,” said Kelly Flaharty, associate vice president, contract operations for Vizient.

Vizient represents a diverse client base that includes academic medical centers, pediatric facilities, community hospitals, integrated health delivery networks and non-acute healthcare providers and has a portfolio that represents more than $156 billion in annual purchasing volume. Through its Innovative Technology Program, Vizient works with client-led councils and task forces to evaluate products for their potential to bring real innovation to healthcare. If it is determined that a product is innovative, Vizient may award a contract outside of the competitive bid cycle.

About Access Vascular

Access Vascular, Inc., based in Billerica, Massachusetts, is a medical device company specializing in developing and commercializing innovative vascular access solutions. The company’s hydrophilic MIMIX® technology is designed to combat thrombosis and infection – with the goal of improving patient outcomes and clinical workflows. For more information, visit www.accessvascularinc.com, or follow us on LinkedIn.

FDA 510(k) K243458 includes the HydroMID single-lumen catheter. The clinical impact has not been evaluated in human clinical trials. The device is not intended for the treatment of existing vein thrombosis.

Genesco Inc. (NYSE: GCO) today announced the launch of its Wrangler® footwear collection, marking an important milestone in its multiyear licensing agreement with Kontoor Brands (NYSE: KTB) and its legendary denim and lifestyle brand.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260914296624/en/

Wrangler Mens Fargo Timber Bark and Wrangler Womens Myrtle Saddle Tan Ivory

The Fall 2026 collection brings Wrangler’s authentic Western style to men’s, women’s and children’s footwear across Western, work and casual lifestyle categories. The collection launches September 15 on Wrangler.com, with availability at select retailers across the United States rolling out later in the season. Retail prices range from $100 to $240.

By pairing our legacy of durability and craftsmanship with Genesco's industry-leading capabilities, we are delivering the superior quality, comfort, and timeless design consumers expect for daily wear."

The assortment features premium materials, including full-grain leather and authentic denim textiles, while select work styles meet ASTM standards for safety-toe protection and slip- and oil-resistant performance.

data.title: Grab to Buy Majority Stake in SoftBank-Backed Atome for About $1.5 Billion
data.description:
By Kimberley Kao 




  Grab has agreed to buy a 60% stake in Atome Financial for $1.49 billion in cash. 



  The transaction is expected to close by the third quarter of 2027, Grab said Tuesday. 



  Atome is a digital-finance platform that operates in Southeast Asia offering buy-now-pay-later, insurance and other services. It is part of Singapore-based Advance Intelligence Group, whose investors include SoftBank and Warburg Pincus. 



  Atome's use of artificial intelligence to assess borrowers and manage risk will "help to scale and strengthen Grab's whole ecosystem," Grab President and Chief Operating Officer Alex Hungate said. 



  Grab also agreed to buy the remaining 40% from Advance Intelligence Group and other shareholders about two years after the initial transaction closes. 



  Grab expects its financial-services segment to generate $500 million in adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization by 2028, with a combined loan portfolio of more than $6 billion. 



  It also raised its overall adjusted Ebitda target for 2028 to $1.7 billion from $1.5 billion. 



  Grab has increasingly turned to acquisitions to support its growth this year. It bought U.S.-based Stash Financial at an enterprise value of $425 million and agreed to buy Foodpanda's Taiwan operations from Delivery Hero for $600 million. 



  The Atome deal would "bring a large external consumer-credit franchise inside another integrated regional platform," Singapore-based research and advisory firm Momentum Works said. 



  Independent [buy-now-pay-later] providers filled a gap while ecommerce and multipurpose digital platforms developed their own financial services, the firm said, noting that gap is narrowing as the platforms expand.

data.title: Dr. Ronald M. Clearie Joins New Jersey Urology, an Affiliate of U.S. Urology Partners
data.description:
Dr. Ronald M. Clearie Joins New Jersey Urology, an Affiliate of U.S. Urology Partners

New Jersey Urology is pleased to announce that Dr. Ronald M. Clearie has joined the practice. Dr. Clearie provides comprehensive urologic care and will support patients with a wide range of urologic needs, reflecting New Jersey Urology’s commitment to accessible, high-quality care across the state.

New Jersey Urology spans more than 20 locations throughout the central and southern regions of the state and is a leading provider of urology and cancer care services, bringing the latest treatments and technologies to the community. New Jersey Urology is an affiliate of U.S. Urology Partners, a partner to community-based practices that is backed by General Atlantic.

Dr. Gordon A. Brown, New Jersey Urology, stated, “On behalf of New Jersey Urology, we are pleased to welcome Dr. Ronald Clearie to our team. His clinical training, patient-centered approach and commitment to high-quality urologic care will be a strong asset to our patients and communities. Dr. Clearie brings a thoughtful, collaborative mindset that aligns with our mission to deliver advanced care in the communities we serve.”

Dr. Ronald Clearie stated, “I am honored to join New Jersey Urology and be part of a team known for clinical excellence, collaboration and compassionate care. I was drawn to New Jersey Urology’s commitment to pairing advanced urologic care with a community-based approach that enables patients to receive care close to home. I look forward to building trusted relationships with patients and working with my colleagues to provide accessible, high-quality care throughout New Jersey.”

Dr. Clearie received his Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine from Rowan University School of Osteopathic Medicine. He also holds a Master of Biomedical Science from Rutgers Robert Wood Johnson Medical School’s Graduate School of Biomedical Science. He earned his Bachelor of Arts in Biological Sciences from Rutgers University’s School of Arts and Sciences, graduating cum laude with a focus in microbiology and anatomy.

In addition to his clinical training, Dr. Clearie has published and presented extensively on topics related to urological research, medicine and patient care. He is also committed to teaching and mentoring others, sharing knowledge to support the next generation of medical professionals. His dedication to service also extends beyond the clinical setting through community involvement and outreach.

“My patient care philosophy begins with listening carefully, communicating clearly and developing individualized treatment plans that reflect each patient’s goals and quality of life. I want patients to feel comfortable asking questions, understanding their options and taking an active role in their care. My goal is to provide evidence-based treatment and compassionate support so every patient feels heard, informed and confident,” Dr. Clearie said.

New Jersey Urology has more than 20 medical offices throughout the following counties: Atlantic, Bucks (PA), Burlington, Camden, Cumberland, Gloucester, Mercer, Middlesex, Monmouth and Somerset.

To learn more about Dr. Clearie or schedule an appointment, visit www.njurology.com. Dr. Clearie will primarily serve patients at the Voorhees and Woodbury offices.

About U.S. Urology Partners

U.S. Urology Partners offers a comprehensive suite of practice management capabilities to its affiliated community-based urology practices, which maintain their local brand and identity that they have established, often over decades. U.S. Urology Partners currently supports six affiliated groups across a network of more than 70 locations in Florida, Indiana, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania and Ohio. data.title: SKE Brings "Cool For The Summer" to Appetite On The Farm 2026 with Vibrant Festival Activation
data.description:
SKE Brings "Cool For The Summer" to Appetite On The Farm 2026 with Vibrant Festival Activation

SKE Brings "Cool For The Summer" to Appetite On The Farm 2026 with Vibrant Festival Activation

PR Newswire

LONDON, Sept. 15, 2026

LONDON, Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SKE, a leading vape brand in the UK and Europe, brought its "Cool For The Summer" campaign to life at Appetite On The Farm 2026, serving as the festival's exclusive vape sponsor on August 29-30 at Kelvedon Hall in Essex, which welcomed more than 20,000 attendees.

Bringing SKE's Summer Spirit to the Festival

As the exclusive vape sponsor, SKE created a dedicated activation space inspired by the character of a British countryside farm. The open-plan timber structure and prominent SKE branding provided a distinctive focal point within the festival site, while its relaxed, welcoming design complemented the outdoor setting of Appetite On The Farm. Conveying the brand ethos of "Enjoy SKE, Enjoy Every Moment", the space quickly became a popular meeting point for festival-goers, with groups of friends stopping by to explore the brand, take photos and participate in activities. The combination of music, social interaction and the festival's outdoor atmosphere helped create a relaxed and energetic environment around the SKE activation.

Flavours, Prizes and Festival Experiences

Throughout the two-day event, SKE offered a programme of activities designed to encourage adult attendees to discover the brand in an informal festival environment.

Product Flavour Sampling: Attendees had the opportunity to explore SKE's flagship SKE BAR and SKE BAR 15K, with a selection of cooling iced, sweet-and-tangy and tropical fruit flavours available to sample.

The SKE BAR combines a familiar design and flavour range with a reusable pod-based format. It features a 500mAh rechargeable battery with Type-C charging and a replaceable pod system using durable, recyclable PCG material. The device is designed to provide consistent flavour throughout its use.

Alongside it, the SKE BAR 15K offered a higher-capacity option, featuring up to 15,000 puffs, an 850mAh battery, a visible top tank and dynamic lighting effects. Its larger format and distinctive design made it particularly suited to the outdoor festival environment.

Hourly Lucky Draws: Adding an element of surprise throughout the weekend, SKE hosted hourly lucky draws each day. Festival-goers had the chance to win exclusive prizes, with each draw creating another moment of excitement around the SKE activation.

One lucky attendee said:

"I came to the festival with friends simply to enjoy the music, so I was pleasantly surprised to receive an unexpected prize as well. The atmosphere at the SKE booth was full of energy, and I really enjoyed the experience. It made the whole festival feel even more special."

Connecting Through Music and Shared Experiences

The UK has always been an important part of SKE's journey, and Appetite On The Farm provided a valuable opportunity to connect directly with adult consumers in a vibrant and authentic festival environment. This activation marks the finale of SKE's Cool For The Summer' campaign, bringing together the energy of summer, music and shared experiences.

SKE is a leading vaping brand in the UK and across Europe, renowned for its user experience, extensive flavour range and product innovation. The brand develops vaping products with a focus on product design, functionality and distinctive aesthetics, serving adult consumers across international markets. Through continued innovation and a user-focused approach, SKE aims to deliver convenient and personalised vaping experiences.
